title: The Fazbear Franchise Protocol
description: is the ultimate experience, combining the base mod, exclusive addons, new structures, collectible animatronics, restoration systems, exploration content, horror challenges, and quality-of-life survival mods into a single enhanced modpack.
body:
The Fazbear Franchise Protocol is a complete Minecraft experience.

This modpack combines with multiple custom expansion addons, introducing new restaurants, structures, animatronics, exploration content, restoration mechanics, survival improvements, and horror-themed challenges.

Whether you want to build a successful business, collect rare animatronics, restore abandoned machines, uncover hidden secrets, or survive dangerous encounters, this modpack offers a complete gameplay experience.

Additional Features

🤖 Hundreds of Animatronics to Discover

Collect, repair, manage, and encounter animatronics throughout your adventure.

🏢 Expanded World Generation

New structures generate naturally across the world.
Every exploration trip can lead to new discoveries.

🎮 Enhanced Survival Experience

Includes additional mods designed to improve progression, exploration, and gameplay quality.

🔍 Secrets Everywhere

Hidden locations, rare animatronics, and special rewards await dedicated players.

💰 Business and Management Gameplay

Build your empire while expanding your collection and managing your resources.

⚠️ Adventure and Horror

Experience both the colorful side of exploration and the darker challenges hidden throughout the world.
